notes: Fresh Sep 24 Toronto-morning Scanner A review of all 197 raw-review candidates. US, Canada and Taiwan were treated as near-equal discovery markets. Generic stock-picking/how-to, evergreen explainers, entertainment/sports/creator noise and weak non-investing trends were rejected; duplicate long-tail searches were merged. Twenty distinct investor-relevant entities/themes were retained. No YouTube metrics were computed manually.
